name: Mountain Bluebird
quote: The bird known as the Mountain Bluebird (Sialia currucoides) is hereby designated as the official state bird of the State of Nevada.

name: Lahontan Cutthroat Trout
quote: The fish known as the Lahontan Cutthroat Trout (Salmo clarki henshawi) is hereby designated as the official state fish of the State of Nevada.

name: Sagebrush
quote: The shrub known as Sagebrush (Artemisia tridentata or trifida) is hereby designated as the official state flower of the State of Nevada.

name: Ichthyosaur
quote: The prehistoric marine reptile known as the Ichthyosaur (genus Shonisaurus), now extinct, is hereby designated as the official state fossil of the State of Nevada.

name: Virgin Valley Black Fire Opal and Nevada Turquoise
yaml_legislation: Adopted by the Nevada Legislature in 1987

name: Vivid Dancer Damselfly
quote: The insect known as the Vivid Dancer Damselfly (Argia vivida) is hereby designated as the official state insect of the State of Nevada.

name: Silver
yaml_legislation: Adopted by the Nevada Legislature in 1977
quote: The metallic element known as silver (Ag) is hereby designated as the official state metal of the State of Nevada.

name: All for Our Country
yaml_legislation: Nevada Statutes of 1866, Chapter XLI; Nevada Revised Statutes § 235.010

name: Desert Tortoise
yaml_legislation: Adopted by the Nevada Legislature in 1989
quote: The reptile known as the Desert Tortoise (Gopherus agassizii) is hereby designated as the official state reptile of the State of Nevada.

name: Sandstone
yaml_legislation: Adopted by the Nevada Legislature in 1987
quote: The rock known as sandstone is hereby designated as the official state rock of the State of Nevada.

name: Orovada Soil Series
quote: The soil series known as Orovada series, classified as coarse-loamy, mixed, superactive, mesic Durinodic Xeric Haplocambids, is hereby designated as the official state soil of the State of Nevada.

name: Single-leaf Pinyon Pine
quote: The trees known as the Single-Leaf Pinon (Pinus monophylla) and the Bristlecone Pine (Pinus longaeva) are hereby designated as the official state trees of the State of Nevada.

name: Picon Punch
quote: The traditional Basque drink known as the Picon Punch is hereby designated as the official state drink of the State of Nevada.

name: Home Means Nevada
yaml_legislation: Adopted by the Nevada Legislature in 1933
quote: The song entitled “Home Means Nevada,” written by Mrs. Bertha Raffetto, of Reno, Nevada, is hereby adopted and declared to be the official state song of the State of Nevada.
